name: Levoy Classification
definition: A classification method that maps raw voxel values to opacity based on the difference between the voxel value and a selected threshold value, modulated by the local gradient to maintain constant isosurface thickness.
summary: Levoy Classification is a transfer function method that maps voxel intensities to opacity using local gradients to maintain constant isosurface thickness, distinguishing it from simple thresholding by preserving layer information in medical and chemical data.
